scope: Native Linux and Mac control listener lifetime across stop/restart
change: Poll and nonblocking accept run under the listener owner lock shared with close. Accept loops retain the owner and reject clients if the server owner changed. Removed duplicate listenerFD/running state from these control servers.

validation.regression: A stopped listener cannot consume the replacement listener pending connection; existing socket ownership and bounded I/O tests pass.

limits: Poll holds the listener lock for up to100ms per call.
Does not establish full operation/generation binding or command execution deadlines.
No physical lifecycle campaign performed for this change.
